title: God's Love Never Fails
truth: God's loving devotion and peace will never leave us, because Jesus made a way for us to be close to God.
points: Mountains and hills can move, but God's love won't.
God promised to always be with His people.
His promise of peace will never be broken.
apply: Today, remember that God's love for you is super strong and will never change. You can trust Him with everything.
prayer: God, thank You for Your amazing love that never gives up on us and for the peace Jesus gives. Amen.
